<<CLEANING A TELESCOPE MIRROR, BRIEFLY>>

TO CLEAN A TELESCOPE MIRROR, START BY WASHING THE SURFACE WITH A WET TOWEL OR A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO REMOVE ANY DEBRIS OR STAIN. MAKE SURE THE MIRROR IS IN A DRY PLACE TO PREVENT WATER FROM STICKING TO THE SURFACE. USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO GENTLY WIP THE MIRROR, MOVING IN A CIRCULAR MOTION TO REMOVE ANY RESIDUAL DEBRIS. AFTER WIPPING, USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO DRY THE MIRROR COMPLETELY. MAKE SURE THE MIRROR IS STABLE AND LEVEL BEFORE PUTTING IT BACK IN THE TELESCOPE. USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO CLEAN THE TELESCOPE CASE AND THE SURROUNDING AREA. CHECK THE MIRROR FOR ANY DAMAGE OR DAMAGE TO THE SURFACE BEFORE USING IT AGAIN. CLEAN THE MIRROR EVERY TIME IT IS USED TO PRESERVE ITS CLEARNESS AND PERFORMANCE. ALWAYS USE A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO CLEAN THE MIRROR AND THE TELESCOPE.
